name: Helium 10
description:
Access your Helium 10 data directly in Claude. Query keyword and ASIN data, analyze campaign performance and profitability, and extract insights from your listings and rank tracking.  

Make Helium 10 a native part of your Claude workflows without switching between dashboards or exporting a single file. Built for active brands with real account data across Research, Ads, and Commerce.  

Requires an active Helium 10 Diamond plan.  Lower-tier accounts are not supported.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Helium 10 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Helium 10 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.helium10.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Helium 10 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helium 10 lists 34 MCP tools, including analyze_keywords, compare_listings, execute_ads_query, get_account_profit_and_loss_breakdown, get_account_profit_and_loss_breakdown_series, get_account_profit_and_loss_summary, get_account_profit_and_loss_summary_series, get_ads_query_list, get_ads_query_materials, get_ads_query_platforms, get_ads_query_schema, and get_brand_seller_profiles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Helium 10?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Helium 10 in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Helium 10 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Helium 10 is developed by Helium 10. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
